remarks: Welcome to your dream home in Norwalk! 31 Karen Drive offers comfort, convenience, and a welcoming atmosphere that you won't want to miss. This oversized raised ranch spans a total of 3,877 square feet of interior living space across two levels. The generous living areas are ideal for both entertaining and everyday living. Gorgeous hardwood floors flow throughout the home. The updated kitchen features sleek appliances, ample counter space, and beautiful cabinetry, while the three-and-a-half bathrooms have also been thoughtfully updated. You'll find yourself envisioning the perfect paint colors for your new home! The home boasts spacious four bedrooms, including a massive primary bedroom suite with plenty of natural light, a full bath, and an abundance of closet space. In addition to a very large three season porch, the outside includes a private backyard offering plenty of room for relaxation, gardening, and outdoor activities. Located in a highly sought-after Norwalk neighborhood, this home is just minutes from shopping, dining, parks, and top-rated schools. With easy access to major highways and public transportation, commuting to surrounding areas is a breeze. Naramake Elementary, Nathan Hale Middle School, and the soon-to-be-completed Norwalk High School are just a short walk away. Schedule a showing today and see why this could be your perfect new home!
